note: True lifts the generator uses for the pilot period (21 Sep - 10 Oct 2026, day 20). Plan offers per group come from the engine; the generator applies these lifts to treated shoppers. Holdout = 10% of every group, no offer. Counts are exact: checkouts = round_half_up(monthly * 20/30 * arm_share); orders = round_half_up(checkouts * rate). plan_offers = the engine plan for the default settings (Part 3 can generate pilot data before the engine exists; the reference engine asserts they match).
day_60: Days 21-60 use the same counts formula; Day 60 results may be computed from counts without generating sessions.
